playerCandidateReview.knownOmissions: Chelsea Gianfranco Zola; Arsenal Sylvain Wiltord positioned RW pending majority check; Leeds Alan Smith vs Fowler and Viduka cap; Newcastle Laurent Robert left vs second striker roles

removed: chelsea/Jody Morris: 2 PL starts; cannot be retained as selected regular second defensive midfielder.
manutd/Raimond van der Gouw: Only 1 PL substitute appearance and 0 starts; Roy Carroll 7 matches and 6 starts.
correctionReview.note: Season membership and low-appearance candidates removed; large outstanding DOB, positions, all-team league starts checks remain.
correctionReview.important: Chelsea Jody Morris (2 league starts) replaced with Jokanovic; MU van der Gouw (0 starts) replaced with Roy Carroll (6); Merson, Anelka, Steve Marlet, Alan Smith, Robbie Keane recovered.

qualifierOmissionDiscovered.preservationNote: 1999-2026 European qualification archive and this season qualifiers[] are intentionally untouched; actual player eligibility is documented as exception only until separate standings correction is permitted.

arsenal.notes: Vieira 35 league starts, Henry 31, Campbell 29; first eleven present. CM pairing / van Bronckhorst role remain unclear.

liverpool.notes: Anelka restored (20 PL matches,13 starts) into Owen/Heskey two-forward rotation as justified third ST.

manutd.notes: Reserve GK Roy Carroll 7 PL matches 6 starts replaces van der Gouw, who had zero league starts.

newcastle.notes: 38/38 Shay Given, 37/37 Solano, 37/36 Shearer, 34/34 Hughes, 36/34 Robert; left-back and CB/rightback positioning pending.

leeds.notes: Smith and Keane restored (19 and 16 league starts), both regular two-forward rotation with Viduka and Fowler. Woodgate 11 league starts versus Matteo 40 all-competition starts; position review remains.

chelsea.notes: Jokanović 12 PL starts replaces Morris 2; Zola 19 starts added third ST; de Goey six GK starts added; Stanić 18 RW vs Grønkjær 11.

blackburn.notes: Premier league 14 existing candidates retained: Friedel, Berg, Duff, Neill, Tugay, Janssen, etc all previously had PL start records; backup RB John Curtis 9 matches/starts under review.

fulham.notes: Steve Marlet 26 league games 21 starts restored as third striker with Saha/Hayles. Full XI represented.

astonvilla.notes: Paul Merson restored (21 apps 18 starts), while Ginola only five PL subs and zero starts at Villa in this season, therefore not added. Main backline/Boateng numbers verified.

ipswich.notes: UEFA fair play entrant omitted from initial qualifiers array (preserved); 17 players restored in preceding commit based on 2001-02 PL-only roster.

playerCandidateReview.auditScope: All ten 2001-02 actual next-season European participant Premier League clubs reviewed, including fair-play Ipswich missing from previously curated qualifier table.
